purpose: Historical dated read-only repository audit as of 2026-11-08. Its seven-repository inventory records the then-observed configuration and is not the current active-product count. As of 2026-11-17, PUI89 has exactly six active products; see ../PUI89_PORTFOLIO_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH_V1.0.md.

evidence_labels.GREEN: Verified from inspected source or GitHub API response.
evidence_labels.AMBER: Gap or risk requiring additional engineering or review.
evidence_labels.GREY: Not verified; do not infer success or failure.

portfolio.scope_note: One discontinued project's project-specific record was removed. The six retained repository records remain a partial historical snapshot dated 2026-11-08; they are not a current active-portfolio inventory or a complete repository audit.

cross_project_findings.finding: All seven project READMEs and supporting standards refer to the four shared contracts. This PR adds four draft JSON Schema definitions (version 0.1.0-draft) and a structural validator. The schemas are proposed, not released or consumed by all project adapters. The Robot Car contracts.py remains a temporary/local implementation.

All seven repositories have at least one active ruleset. One representative active ruleset per repository was inspected; each requires a pull request and prevents non-fast-forward updates, but each sampled configuration requires zero approving reviews and no code-owner review or review-thread resolution.
25 rulesets total: 24 active and one disabled. The historical audit recorded repository-specific ruleset counts. Review every ruleset's conditions and effects before consolidation.
The classic branch-protection endpoint returned HTTP 403 for all inspected repositories. Classic protection and required status checks could not be verified.

97 workflow files were listed across the repositories inspected. A PUI89 security-audit workflow is present in each repository. The inspected repositories included additional security-analysis workflow files.
This audit did not run project test suites or verify latest workflow outcomes. Workflow-file presence is not proof of a passing run.
No maturity percentages or scores were recomputed; they are excluded until linked to current, reproducible evidence.

next_actions.action: Review the four draft schemas, then establish a canonical versioned package and migrate project adapters to consume or validate against it.
Maintain a dated machine-readable register and dependency-free structural validator; update only from traceable evidence.
Link the same dated register from both Shared AI Core language pages; keep equivalent claims and limitations.
Keep project-specific facts in each README and link to one central portfolio register rather than duplicating portfolio-wide status.
Review all rulesets and classic protection manually, confirm required CI checks, and avoid weakening enforcement during cleanup.
Add canonical contract conformance tests for missing, malformed, stale, noisy and conflicting inputs, uncertainty, abstention and safe-stop outcomes.
Use IMPLEMENTED, TESTED, MEASURED, SIMULATION-ONLY, PROPOSED and NOT VALIDATED consistently across public materials.

shared_ai_core_schema_draft.safety_invariant: ActionProposal requires human approval, advisory_only authority and actuation_allowed=false
shared_ai_core_schema_draft.validation_scope: Dependency-free structural checks only; full JSON Schema meta-validation and project adapter integration remain future work.

current_portfolio_scope.note: This current-scope annotation does not rewrite the historical repository, ruleset, workflow or commit evidence recorded in the 2026-11-08 snapshot.
